bugs.what: Menu action descriptions show wrong DC values. Watchtower carving menu said 'roll 6+' but actual DC was 9. Barrow crack menu said 'roll 7+' but actual DC was 10. Misleads player on success likelihood.

confusions: DC mismatch makes it unclear whether grace checks are actually failing or if the menu is wrong — initially thought I was picking wrong actions
suggestions: Fix menu DC displays to match actual check values so player can make informed attempts
Consider adding combat encounters — I never fought anything despite having combat options
Test crown path as alternative to verses for story variety
Grace check perk (Fleetfoot) was valuable; consider tuning DCs so perks feel more impactful
